search_text: published ZDI-11-060 ZDI-CAN-445 Novell eDirectory Malformed NCP Request Denial of Service Vulnerability 2011-02-07 CVE-2010-4327 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2010-4327 9.0 ['Novell'] ['eDirectory'] This vulnerability allows attackers to deny services on vulnerable installations of Novell eDirectory. Authentication is not required in order to trigger this vulnerability. The flaw exists within Novell's eDirectory Server's NCP implementation. Novell's eDirectory Server binds to port 524 for processing NCP requests. When the application processes a malformed FileSetLock request, the service will become unresponsive resulting in an inability to authenticate to that server. Novell has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
